subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same-non standard dice are shown. Which letter will be on the face opposite to the face with the letter 'Q'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f8cbcd09e1f5faea08c6159355166878a0a73b86c31065c11ba4b15e69ff0fb.png]
solution:
Given: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f8cbcd09e1f5faea08c6159355166878a0a73b86c31065c11ba4b15e69ff0fb.png] 

**Logic: If two dice have the same face value in the given image then their clockwise or anticlockwise number are the opposite numbers in the dice.**

When moving in a clockwise direction from the common face (T) in dice (1) and (2):

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2eeadaba68a2b4293c04637862496d330d18586b4c2404af79652dc390a77059.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b2a2446d1049ed2c2dec5c17fe2844270cca5d874b684cfbe6c144dc75fcd72.png] 

From both dice:

 
 

 **Dice 1**
 T
 S
 **Q**
 
 

 **Dice 2**
 T
 R
 **U**
 
 

Now, Q is opposite to U, thus Q will be on the face opposite to the face having the letter U.

Hence, the correct answer is **"U"**
